data.narrative:
Dusty Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Tessa Lau and Philipp Herget. The company has raised $70M+ to date. The comparable universe spans one public company (277810.KQ) and eight private firms in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Given the scarcity of narrow-stage comparables in this sector, valuation relies on the Stage-Progression method. Using $4M as a proxy for total capital raised, application of a 2.5x step-up multiplier—typical for progression from Seed to next stage—yields an implied value of $9M. The Peer-Median approach was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage datapoints within the target valuation tier; only one same-stage peer exists in the broader universe, falling short of the three-company threshold required for robust median calculation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $7M to $10M, with $9M as the central estimate. Material uncertainty remains around the appropriate stage-progression multiplier for a robotics company at this maturity with $70M+ raised, which exceeds typical Seed outcomes and may warrant upward adjustment. Lack of narrow peer coverage represents the primary limitation; additional private comparables or later-stage robotics transactions would strengthen conviction in this range.
